scripts.build: npm run extensions && npm run build -w app
scripts.check: npm run extensions && npm run typecheck && node scripts/contrast.mjs && npm test && npm run build

ATLAS_OWNER_SECRET.description: Your setup code: any 16 or more characters you'll remember for a few minutes. You type it once in the app to make your passkey, and again only if you ever lose every passkey.

ATLAS_DATA_KEY.description: Atlas's own key for locking your keys, sign-ins and vault: 32 or more random characters. Keep a copy somewhere safe; if it's ever changed, put the old one back and everything opens again.
